answer_1.quote: We treat knowledge-grounded response generation in the media dialog setting as a language modeling task: given a dialog history H and a grounding knowledge document K, we seek to predict the next utterance x by maximizing the likelihood p(x|H, K).

answer_2.quote: To measure the fidelity of generated responses, we compute BPE perplexity and BLEU between generated and gold utterances.

answer_4.quote: We perform pairwise comparisons between responses generated by our best system and those generated by four strong baselines... Our human evaluation study (details in Appendix §B) measures three aspects of response quality on 100 test examples
answer_4.guideline: How relevant the response is with respect to dialog history; How relevant the response is with respect to grounding documents; Whether the generated response is fluent English.
